company.shortDescription: Innovist is a personal care company that develops products for hair, skin, and sun care.
company.description: Innovist is a personal care company that develops products for hair, skin, and sun care under brands like Bare Anatomy, Chemist At Play, and SunScoop. The company focuses on creating science-backed formulations that are clean and transparent. Innovist offers a range of products, including customized hair shampoos, body lotions, and sunscreens, designed to address various concerns such as dandruff, dryness, and sun protection.
